shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab/monolith with rounded or pointed top
human or anthropomorphic figures shown frontally/in profile
symbolic signs or emblems arranged around the figure(s)
justification: Both are upright relief-carved slabs bearing an anthropomorphic figure accompanied by symbolic signs, with disc-like circular motifs among them, which is a generic correspondence found in many unrelated traditions. B shows a clearly narrative scene of two profile figures facing each other across offerings with rows of script-like signs above, while A shows a single massive frontal statue-like body with a broad head, headdress-like top, pendant/ornament motifs and a large central ring on the chest — different figural conventions, proportions and no interaction between figures.
